summary: End-to-end verification of the OkaMoney AI Tips Results Tracker feature (real per-market hit-rates + 3-day public view + admin analytics + WhatsApp ticket tracking). Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_results_tracker_api.py = 16/16 PASSED covering PUBLIC /api/results/recent (default 3, days=10 capped at 3, full day/tip/whatsapp shape, odds+selection present, whatsapp legs present); ADMIN gating (403 on wrong key for /stats, /pending, /settle, /simulate); ADMIN /stats shape (hit_rate/won/settled/roi/total_picks/by_market with hit_rate/won/total/avg_odds/roi per market); ADMIN /pending flat list with pick_id/home/away/selection/odds/result and surface=='whatsapp' entries present; ADMIN /simulate on day-2 grades all pending (post-condition: 0 pending remain that date) and stats.settled > 0 afterwards; ADMIN /settle on yesterday updates 1 tip to 'void' and GET /pending reflects the change. Frontend: /games shows 100 TIP buttons; the free-tier tip modal shows odds patterns like '@ 1.22'/'@ 1.28'/'@ 1.50' alongside % confidence (Requirement (a) met); Results tab present, when clicked shows 3-day selector (Sat/Fri/Thu), Won/Lost/Pending legend, summary bar (Total=107 Won=75 Lost=32 Hit Rate=70.1%), WhatsApp Daily Tickets group (4 tickets: Build A Bet, Mixed Parlay, Big Odds, Mega Odds) with per-leg odds ('@ 1.50' etc.), and per-game groups (31) each with tips + odds + result icon (Requirements (b) and 'whatsapp included' met). /admin/results: wrong admin key rejected (403 + 'Invalid admin key' UI message); correct key 'okamoney_admin_2024' unlocks the page showing 7/14/30/All Time range tabs, stat cards (Hit Rate 71.2%, Won/Settled 153/215, ROI -4.1%, Total 216), By-Market table with 16 markets, Settle section with 324 won/lost/void buttons and a 'Simulate (demo)' button (Requirements (c) and (d) met). No critical bugs found; all listed requirements are satisfied.

minor.issue: In-memory results_tracker singleton is created twice: services/results_tracker.py:get_results_tracker() returns a module-level singleton, but server.py:42 also constructs 'results_tracker = ResultsTracker(db)' directly and uses it for older endpoints (/picks/{id}/result, /stats, /history, /pending). Both share the same MongoDB collection so behaviour is correct, but code path is inconsistent — new endpoints call the singleton factory, old ones use the top-level. Recommend using the factory everywhere.

action_items: OPTIONAL: unify singleton usage — replace 'results_tracker = ResultsTracker(db)' in server.py with 'get_results_tracker(db)' so old and new endpoints share one instance path.

OPTIONAL (test coverage): add an idempotency assertion for ensure_snapshot — hitting /api/results/recent twice should not duplicate picks in the pick_results collection (currently covered indirectly by the settle test that finds an already-graded pick on yesterday, but not asserted explicitly).
critical_code_review_comments: results_tracker.py uses random.random() in simulate_settle — non-deterministic across runs. Fine for a clearly-labelled demo, but consider seeding with the date to make simulate results reproducible day-to-day.

In ResultsTracker._day_view, 'settled' does not include 'void'/'half_won'/'half_lost' (only won+lost), which matches the summary UI on GamesPage but diverges from get_statistics where settled = total - void (includes half_won/half_lost). The mismatch is minor but worth aligning if half-results are ever produced.
server.py is now ~1640 lines — a lot of endpoint noise. Consider splitting into routers (auth, picks, wallet, whatsapp, results, admin) once feasible.

results_tracker.py:_snap_doc pins created_at to midnight of date_str; get_statistics filters by created_at >= now - N days, which means 'yesterday' picks may briefly fall outside a strict 7-day window at UTC boundaries. Not a functional bug but a subtle edge case.

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 in test_results_tracker_api.py). Combined with the pre-existing suites this run is 60/61 total.
success_rate.frontend: 100% for the results-tracker flows (tip modal odds, /games Results tab, /admin/results gating + unlock + range tabs + by-market + settle + simulate).

seed_data_creation: The endpoints self-seed via ensure_snapshot(date) — snapshots for the last 30 days are auto-created when /api/admin/results/stats?days=30 is first hit. Tests are idempotent because ensure_snapshot skips dates that already have a marker.
